description: The images of a look that wasn't ready when it was asked (look_at_draft or look_at_pro_draft answered a jobId).

inline.description: Return the images inside the answer (default true). false returns their URLs only.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for the render before answering (default 50). If it isn't ready, the answer has a jobId for get_frames.

name: get_frames
title: Get a look's images
